match.settings.title: Settings
match.settings.camera.pan_speed.label: Camera speed
match.settings.camera.pan_speed.hint: How fast WASD pans the view.
match.settings.camera.smoothing.label: Zoom smoothing
match.settings.camera.smoothing.hint: How gently zoom settles on its target.
match.settings.graphics.quality.label: Graphics quality
match.settings.graphics.quality.hint: Visual quality only; it never changes the game's rules or speed.
match.settings.graphics.adaptive.label: Automatic optimization
match.settings.graphics.adaptive.hint: Temporarily lowers quality under sustained performance pressure.
match.setup.victory.caption: Victory
match.setup.victory.military.label: Military
match.setup.victory.military.hint: The match ends only when the enemy centre falls.
match.setup.victory.military_regional.hi: Military victory still stands. On top of it, whoever holds both strategic passes together for long enough wins. A pass is taken by the control radius of a road-linked outpost, not by sending units to stand on it.
match.setup.mode.story.label: Story tour
match.setup.mode.story.blurb: Learn through objectives given in order.
match.setup.mode.story.hint: A normal match, with objectives given in order. You learn the road, depot and control-area rules by playing them; when the chain ends the match carries on as a free game. The map opens under fog of war: scouting is the tour's first lesson.
match.setup.mode.free.label: Free match
match.setup.mode.free.blurb: No objectives; work the rules out yourself.
match.setup.mode.free.hint: No objectives. This game's road/depot logistics and its centre-led upgrade ladder differ from the genre's usual rules; you discover all of it yourself.
match.setup.fog.caption: Fog of war
match.setup.fog.on.label: On
match.setup.fog.on.hint: The map is dark until explored. Enemy units you cannot see are hidden, and buildings you have scouted stay in memory. The enemy plays under the same fog — it knows your units only once it sees them.
match.setup.fog.off.label: Off
match.setup.fog.off.hint: The whole map and both sides' units are visible from the start. Scouting and surprise stop mattering; the match becomes a straight economy and army race.
match.setup.difficulty.caption: Difficulty
match.setup.difficulty.easy.label: Easy
match.setup.difficulty.easy.hint: The opponent reacts late and takes no economy advantage. For learning the rules or trying an opening.
match.setup.difficulty.normal.label: Normal
match.setup.difficulty.normal.hint: The fair baseline: no economy bonus, a measured reaction time. This is the opponent the balance is tuned against.
match.setup.difficulty.hard.label: Hard
match.setup.difficulty.hard.hint: The opponent reacts almost instantly and takes a small economy advantage. Not cheating but tempo: it sees exactly as much as you do.
